content.title: About
content.content: Organic puffed quinoa is a light, crunchy snack made from whole quinoa grains that have been puffed. Quinoa (Chenopodium quinoa) originates from the Andes, where it has been cultivated for over 5,000 years. The puffed form retains most of the grain’s nutrients and is suitable for vegetarians, vegans, and those avoiding gluten.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Quinoa is considered a "complete protein" because it contains all nine essential amino acids.
The organic label guarantees no synthetic pesticides or GMOs were used.
Puffed quinoa is made without added oil, making it low‑calorie yet nutrient‑dense.
Quinoa is rich in iron, magnesium, and zinc, making it a valuable addition to the diet.
Traditional Andean cuisine used quinoa as porridge, but today it is turned into snacks, granola, and bars.

items.title: High protein content
items.content: Quinoa provides about 14 % protein by weight, helping support muscle maintenance and satiety.

items.title: Rich in dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber aids digestion, helps regulate blood sugar levels, and supports a healthy gut microbiome.

items.title: Source of micronutrients
items.content: Quinoa supplies magnesium, iron, phosphorus, zinc, and B‑vitamins essential for energy metabolism.

items.title: Gluten‑free
items.content: Suitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Phytonutrients such as quercetin and kaempferol help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Quinoa allergy
items.content: A small number of individuals may experience an allergic reaction; discontinue use if symptoms appear.

items.title: Saponin content
items.content: Saponins can cause mild stomach irritation in sensitive people; processing usually reduces their levels.

items.title: Caloric density in large portions
items.content: Although light, puffed quinoa can be over‑eaten; moderation is key for calorie control.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Puffed quinoa can be enjoyed straight from the bag, added to granola, yogurt, smoothie bowls, or used in baking as a crunchy topping. It’s a convenient on‑the‑go snack that requires no preparation.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. For extended shelf life, keep refrigerated to maintain crispness and prevent fat oxidation.
